label: Contractor / Remodeling / Roofing (Warm Amber)
description: Warm, cinematic dark theme validated on Built Right Construction (remodeling). Good default starting point for contractors, roofers, remodelers, and similar trade businesses. Colors/copy should still be adjusted per client brand where they have one.
notes: colorFamily 'stone' means generate.ts should replace Tailwind's cool-toned 'slate-*' classes with warm-toned 'stone-*' across the copied site (word-boundary safe: only 'slate-' tokens, never substrings like 'translate').
Header is already the shared-template default (transparent, fixed, solidifies on scroll) — no extra action needed.

Give each service in content.json an 'image' field (local /images/*.jpg or a verified real Unsplash URL) so Services.astro and the service detail page hero both show real photography instead of the missing /service-N.jpg default.

Populate home.scrollShowcase.images and home.hero.bgImage in content.json — GalleryScrollChoreography and Hero both silently fall back to non-existent /gallery-*.jpg / /hero-bg.jpg files if these are left unset.
Give every service and the homepage 4-6 FAQ entries, not just one placeholder 'Why choose us for X' each.
Avoid fabricating ratings/review counts/certifications not supplied by the client — TrustBar already computes its rating average from real content.json reviews rather than a hardcoded stat.
